findings.explanation: The root inventory and executable target place manuscript sources, numerical code, outputs, image archive and three project modules within one logical tree. This supports met for nesting; the separately identified nested source-URL defect belongs to reachability.

Following root → data/raw_eyegaze reveals a genuinely machine-specific URL for src/lab-eyetracking. The recorded numerical inputs instead name released eyegaze files, so partial accurately distinguishes incomplete ancestral reachability from a failure of every required input. No live retrieval failure is established.

The recipe installs the scientific stack and the executed Makefile installs the separately pinned REMoDNaV package. Package declarations count as inclusion under rule 7; physical vendoring or a full dependency lock is not required by this item.

Frozen source identities and read-only Git tree/history inspection establish version control for code, manuscript and configuration. An incomplete capture must not be interpreted as the original author leaving deleted or untracked files.

Git tree entries and frozen annex pointers identify the large archived image layers, while the raw-data documentation explicitly describes git-annex content storage. Missing layer/data bytes in this cohort do not negate the observed versioning mechanism.

The numerical run declares img and results_def.tex outputs, container/image as an extra input, and exit 0. The linked label-generation record names bash code/compute_all.sh and its inputs/outputs but no exact environment. That concrete incomplete chain supports partial independently of the weaker absence-of-manuscript-run argument.

The current README explicitly provides prerequisite installation links and commands for clone, numerical reproduction and manuscript compilation. It also labels the obsolete instructions. The two historical routes are disclosed, so their mere coexistence is not a rule-10 contradiction.

The documented results-containerized tag resolves offline to the cited completed run, whose command and input/output lists supply an actionable numerical entry point. The separate main.pdf command exists in Docker-Makefile; this item does not require this review to execute it.

Root analysis paths are relative, but root → label module exposes executable submission generators with a fixed private initialdir and interpreter path. Under the assessment’s inclusion of linked computation, partial is supported. Windows prompt examples and container-internal cleanup paths are not host-path defects.

The current numerical route’s external imports map to declared NumPy, pandas, SciPy, matplotlib, seaborn, scikit-learn and statsmodels; REMoDNaV and its imported utilities are present. DataLad has an explicit fallback inside the container and the run declares prefetch inputs. Rendering tools are also in the recipe. This supports the stated current-route dependency finding, without claiming a fresh installation was tested.

The README documents platforms and major host tools. The discovered adapter nevertheless assumes docker on PATH usable by a non-root user, and the included legacy scheduler route carries a private initialdir and inherited host environment. The partial verdict has specific evidence rather than relying on a platform-name heuristic.

There is an explicit current-route prerequisite list plus a Debian-based internal package specification. This is sufficient for the checklist’s clear-list question; the narrower undocumented assumptions remain appropriately visible under must/011.

The Docker recipe and adapter registration are tracked files. The completed build record also links recipe input to archived image output, supporting met without equating the mutable base tag with an exact rebuild lock.

Executable build/save and conversion commands are preserved in history; the recipe has a subsequent tracked edit and the archive a later OCI update. This exceeds a declaration with no instances. The identical should/008 judgment and duplicate flags are consistent. The old recipe diff itself is unavailable offline, so its exact content change is supported only by history metadata.

Current archive metadata gives config/layer hashes, and the adapter loads and runs the image by computed config identity rather than pulling latest. The recorded run tree contains the earlier saved image. Thus exact-environment identification is supported; byte verification and recipient availability remain separate unknowns.

The annex metadata supplies a download location, not an observed independent recipient retrieval. The cohort forbids acquisition and omits image layers. not-checked follows the instrument’s explicit publication evidence rule and should not become either a pass or a retrieval-failure finding.

The documented clone/rerun/container-run route describes acquisition, image download size and environment use, and the registration binds it to the saved image. These are concrete instructions rather than an unsupported claim that a container exists.

Following the root links shows Git revision identities for software and datasets, with DataLad/git-annex extending the same Git-based organization for large content. No competing version-control system is required by these components.

The completed numerical run and later image compatibility operation are real but do not establish regular testing of the paper instructions. The linked Travis definition concerns REMoDNaV package tests, not regular execution of the paper workflow. not-checked is preferable to inferring absence from missing root CI.

Raw recordings and derived labels are distinct pinned datasets; package code, paper analysis, figures and environment files have explicit separate locations and roles. The native method accepts these functional boundaries without requiring every directory to become an independent repository.

The historical record supplies actual completion with outputs and exit 0, while the discovered adapter starts a new docker run container. Together they meet the equivalent-completed-run rule; the conclusion is not based on a workflow definition alone. It does not demonstrate scientific validity or a new replay by this reviewer.

A new Docker container is removed after each invocation, but the configured HOME is the fixed /tmp/dockertmp inside the bind-mounted project. Cleanup follows make with &&, so a failed payload leaves that HOME on the host; the next invocation continues after mkdir fails because mkdir is followed by a semicolon. Concurrent invocations also share it. Therefore full per-execution isolation is not established by --rm. Moreover, the included label producer invokes host Python without spawning a disposable environment.
findings.suggested_correction: Use partial for the declared scope: fresh containers cover the paper route, but HOME is shared/persistent after failure and the linked label route does not create a disposable environment. Recommend a unique run HOME with unconditional cleanup, and state explicitly whether label production is included.

findings.explanation: The frozen history provides one analysis environment build/run and a later load/start/save conversion, without a demonstrated regular reconstitution schedule. not-checked is justified. However, numerical replay is not itself required by this environment-reconstitution item; a repeatable exact-image restoration check could settle it without repeating the science.
findings.suggested_correction: Keep not-checked, but describe the missing evidence as regular restoration/identity checks of the recorded environment, not necessarily regular scientific replay.

findings.explanation: The image is archived as versioned content under the research root, with build/save and conversion records. It is more than a registry name. Frozen-package omission of its layers is an inspection limitation, so met for the archiving mechanism is defensible without asserting live retrieval.

This is the exact duplicate of must/014. The same runnable maintenance commands and tracked changes support the same verdict, and both native responses retain upstream-duplicate rather than presenting this as a second independent check.

The consumed recording/evaluation inputs and software are presented as publicly accessible; no access-controlled numerical component is identified. A broken ancestral local URL is not evidence of a restricted-access policy. The empty-subject N/A is therefore reasonable for the scoped route, rather than a citation-free met.

The subject consists of independently maintained datasets/software, not routine Python dependencies. Their Gitlinks are explicit, but the nested ancestral source uses a nonportable local URL. partial follows rule 7’s retrievable-link interpretation even though the probe’s literal submodule-shape test can pass.

The root gives a useful component overview and commands. In contrast, following the labels link reaches instructions for Condor scripts absent from the frozen inventory, whereas the delivered producer is compute_all.sh. That concrete navigation mismatch supports partial more clearly than a general demand for additional recombination prose.

Pins and root-relative BIDS interfaces support independent component boundaries. The cited private initialdir is a portability problem in an obsolete submit generator; stale instructions are a documentation problem. Neither citation establishes that updating one currently composed module requires changing another or breaks its interface. The negative judgment is therefore not yet supported on this criterion’s property.
findings.suggested_correction: Separate the portability/documentation findings from update coupling. Identify a concrete cross-module interface or update incompatibility before retaining partial; otherwise judge the version-pinned, independently maintained boundaries on their own evidence, or use not-checked for untested update compatibility.

findings.explanation: Gitlinks compose the inputs and software, registration selects the archived environment, and executable targets connect numerical generation to manuscript rendering. The completed numerical record corroborates the composition mechanism. This item need not imply every remote component is retrievable today.

Root documentation and module path/URL metadata provide a usable navigation mechanism, supplemented by package usage documentation. The labels documentation deficiency remains visible under may/002; it does not erase the existence of overall navigation tooling.

limitations: Inspection-only review of the assigned anonymized native JSON and frozen manifest e3c6253bced7d959cd59873c3d49d166bf5793906bcdf65e49e265076d215499; no peer assessments, reviews, examples or gold answers were consulted.

No network, payload acquisition, scientific execution, container build or independent recipient retrieval was performed. Binary data, SVG/style payloads and container layers are omitted by the capture; these omissions are not observed retrieval failures or evidence of scientific disagreement.

Git reads used GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1. Tree identities and the results-containerized tag were checked offline; an attempted historical recipe diff was unavailable because the frozen partial clone omits an old blob. No acquisition was attempted.

The pinned checklist hash and native response validator pass. All 31 criterion IDs are present. Native status counts are MUST 12 met/4 partial/1 not-checked (17 total), SHOULD 6 met/2 not-checked/1 not-applicable (9 total), MAY 2 met/3 partial (5 total). No numeric score or denominator inconsistency appears in the supplied JSON; separate report/URL/probe products were not read.

All 23 distinct cited frozen source files matched their manifest and assessment SHA-256 values. Commit citations were checked through supplied histories and selected offline Git reads. The adapter citation in the assessment uses a release tag; this review cites the frozen adapter by content hash rather than treating that tag as immutable.

Original probe receipts were outside the assigned input and were not consulted. Probe-override explanations were checked against source evidence, not accepted as proof of those original probe outputs. The source was not presented as a complete original working-tree capture.

Agreement denotes support under the assigned instrument and inspection boundary, not human approval, scientific validity or successful contemporary replay. Runtime model identity was not independently observable.
